_meta.description: Maps cTrader pair keys (as used elsewhere in this project, e.g. config.broker_symbol_key output) to the exact asset name shown on the Binomo trading terminal. binomo_executor.py only trades pairs present in BOTH this map and the live cTrader symbol list - anything missing here is silently skipped, never guessed.
_meta.how_to_verify: Names below were read directly from the live Binomo asset picker (search box + Currencies/Crypto filters) via a logged-in session on 2026-08-09. Re-verify periodically - Binomo can rename or delist assets without notice. Log into the terminal, open the '+' asset picker, search each base currency, and compare against the names here.
_meta.otc_warning: Binomo trades most forex pairs under a separate '(OTC)' name on weekends/off-hours (e.g. 'EUR/USD (OTC)') on its own synthetic feed - this is a DIFFERENT price series from cTrader's live feed. binomo_executor._resolve_binomo_asset_name() picks binomo_name on weekdays (UTC) and otc_name on weekends; a null otc_name means that pair is simply not tradable on Binomo on weekends (confirmed for USDCHF/EURJPY as of verification date - no OTC listing was found for either). Crypto (BTCUSD/ETHUSD) has no plain-name listing at all on Binomo - only the '(OTC)' name exists, so binomo_name is null and otc_name is used every day.
